How the model works ↗

BEHIND THE VIEW / THE MODEL

Curiosity, with
its workings visible.

Every result starts with assumptions. This first experiment makes them easy to inspect.

01 / GRAVITY

A path, not a preset.

Newtonian gravity changes the planet’s velocity at each fixed one-day step. A velocity Verlet integrator advances the trajectory.

02 / STARLIGHT

Light follows distance.

A Sun-like star supplies a blackbody luminosity. The planet’s incident flux falls with the square of its distance.

03 / HONEST LIMITS

A starting point.

The star is fixed; additional planets, collisions, clouds, chemistry and life are not yet simulated. Energy drift is a numerical diagnostic, not a guarantee of accuracy.

THE LONG VIEW / WHAT COMES NEXT

A small beginning.
A much larger story.

The blueprint follows matter from early cosmic environments toward stars, planets, chemistry and evolving creatures. Each stage needs its own models and validation.
